verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says its AI assistants handle employees' expenses, including "fetching receipts" and "offering policy help" (brex-docs-23). A review agent "follows up with anyone out of compliance" (brex-docs-16), and Brex AI applies spend rules to every transaction (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-41), which covers receipt-chasing and some policy guidance. However, these are thin marketing claims, and other parts of the story are not evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of the assistant explaining card declines, an explicit pre-spend "can I expense this?" conversational flow, in-depth first-party docs on the assistant's conversational behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
